entities.name: NAS security mode control procedure
entities.description: Procedure to take an EPS security context into use, and initialize and start NAS signalling security between UE and MME with corresponding EPS NAS keys and security algorithms.

entities.name: EPS security context
entities.description: Security context containing EPS NAS keys and security algorithms used for NAS signalling protection.

entities.name: NAS signalling security
entities.description: Security protection for NAS signalling between UE and MME established through security mode control.

entities.name: NAS security algorithms
entities.description: Cryptographic algorithms used for NAS signalling integrity and confidentiality protection.

entities.name: Uplink NAS COUNT
entities.description: Counter value used in the latest SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message for replay protection.

entities.name: UE radio capability ID
entities.description: Identifier representing UE radio capabilities that can be requested during security mode control.

relations.description: Procedure takes EPS security context into use.
Procedure initializes and starts NAS signalling security.
Procedure can change NAS security algorithms for current EPS security context.
Procedure can change uplink NAS COUNT value.
Procedure can request UE radio capability ID from UE.
